features.description: Declarative PrereqProbe registry with pure-set profiles + per-probe activation_condition + stable JSON envelope with schema_version. Build PrereqProbe dataclass at scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/prereq_registry.py with fields {name, probe_command: list[str] | callable, version_constraint, fix_url, fix_command: list[str], auto_install_safe: bool, why_needed, required_for_profiles: frozenset[str], activation_condition: ActivationCondition, severity_when_inactive: SeverityWhenInactive, timeout_s}. ActivationCondition is an enum: always | github_remote_present | auditor_codex_selected | dispatch_requires_push | firebase_target_set. SeverityWhenInactive is enum: omit | advisory | warn (controls how probe appears when activation_condition is false). Five PURE-SET profiles (no conditional pseudo-profiles): core, discord, firebase-dashboard, openclaw, ci. NO `maintainer` profile in v0 (defers to Roadmap Plan 5/7). Wire into scripts/dontpanic_doctor.py via NEW --profile=<name> CLI flag — `dontpanic doctor` with NO flags keeps existing CheckResult pipeline + existing probe set + existing 0/1/2 exit-code matrix unchanged (backwards-compat invariant). `--json` extended additively with prereq_probes envelope carrying explicit `schema_version` string. NEW `--profile-strict` flag promotes warn → fail under the selected profile (avoids clash with existing --strict-codes / --validate-plans-strict / --architecture-drift-strict namespaces). Conditional severity examples baked in: codex CLI is advisory under --profile=core unless activation_condition.auditor_codex_selected resolves true (env reads target environments.json + invocation flags); gh auth is warn under --profile=core when github_remote_present, omit when no remote, fail under --profile=ci. Python <3.10 + missing claude CLI are unconditional fails under core. Network probes run in ThreadPoolExecutor with per-probe 2s cap; full sweep <=10s wall clock. **F001 ships independently; operator pause point before F002-F004.**
steps: Read scripts/dontpanic_doctor.py end-to-end. Map the existing CheckResult/run_all_checks/render_text/render_json pipeline. Document the seam where the new profile-aware path plugs in without touching the legacy no-flag path.

Create scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/prereq_registry.py with PrereqProbe dataclass (frozen=True): {name: str, probe_command: list[str] | Callable, version_constraint: str | None, fix_url: str, fix_command: list[str], auto_install_safe: bool, why_needed: str, required_for_profiles: frozenset[str], activation_condition: ActivationCondition, severity_when_inactive: SeverityWhenInactive, timeout_s: float = 2.0}. Define ActivationCondition enum (always | github_remote_present | auditor_codex_selected | dispatch_requires_push | firebase_target_set) + SeverityWhenInactive enum (omit | advisory | warn). Define ProfileRegistry with 5 pure-set profiles: core, discord, firebase-dashboard, openclaw, ci — each profile is frozenset[str] of probe names. NO conditional pseudo-profiles. NO `maintainer` profile in v0.

Define ~10 initial probes carefully scoped per operator review: (a) python-version: required_for=core+discord+firebase-dashboard+openclaw+ci, activation_condition=always, FAIL when <3.10; (b) claude-cli: required_for=core+all, activation_condition=always, FAIL when missing (default executor); (c) git-user-email: required_for=core+all, activation_condition=always, FAIL when missing; (d) gh-auth-status: required_for=ci, activation_condition=github_remote_present, severity_when_inactive=warn-under-core / omit-otherwise — i.e. WARN under core when github_remote_present resolves true, OMIT under core when no github remote, FAIL under ci always; (e) codex-cli: required_for=ci+openclaw, activation_condition=auditor_codex_selected, severity_when_inactive=advisory — i.e. ADVISORY under core unless auditor_codex_selected, FAIL under ci+openclaw always; (f) anthropic-api-network: required_for=core+all, activation_condition=always, 2s cap; (g) jq: required_for=core+all, activation_condition=always; (h) firebase-cli: required_for=firebase-dashboard, activation_condition=firebase_target_set, OMIT under core; (i) gcloud: required_for=firebase-dashboard, activation_condition=firebase_target_set, OMIT under core; (j) sa-key: required_for=firebase-dashboard, activation_condition=firebase_target_set, OMIT under core; (k) discord-webhook + sanitization-regex: required_for=discord, activation_condition=always (within discord profile), OMIT under other profiles; (l) openrouter-key + openclaw-cli: required_for=openclaw, activation_condition=always (within openclaw), OMIT otherwise.

Each probe MUST carry fix_url (vendor docs link) AND fix_command (list[str]; NO shell strings). Auto_install_safe defaults to False. Probes with auto_install_safe=True ship as opt-in execution targets for F002 (NOT this feature). Examples of fix_command as list[str]: ['brew', 'install', 'jq'] / ['gh', 'auth', 'login'] / ['echo', 'Install Python 3.10+ from https://python.org']. NEVER shell strings like 'brew install jq && gh auth login'.

Define ActivationContext dataclass that resolves activation_condition values at runtime: github_remote_present (read `git remote -v` for github.com); auditor_codex_selected (read target environments.json + invocation flags); dispatch_requires_push (resolve from plan inventory + commit_policy); firebase_target_set (read environments.json target_project). ActivationContext is built once per probe sweep, passed to all probes uniformly.

Implement ProbeRunner that: (a) builds ActivationContext, (b) filters probes by required_for_profiles for the selected profile, (c) for each filtered probe evaluates activation_condition against ActivationContext and computes effective severity (fail | warn | advisory | omit) for the selected profile, (d) executes probe_command via subprocess.run(argv, shell=False) or callable in ThreadPoolExecutor with per-probe timeout (default 2s). Returns ProbeResult per probe. Full sweep wall clock <=10s for all five profiles combined.

Extend scripts/dontpanic_doctor.py with NEW --profile=<name> argparse flag — NO default. When --profile is absent, doctor runs the existing legacy path unchanged (existing CheckResult set, existing render_text, existing 0/1/2 exit-code matrix). When --profile=<name> is supplied, doctor runs the NEW profile-aware path: ProbeRunner output rendered as a 'Prereq probes for profile=X:' section (text mode) or extended JSON envelope with `prereq_probes` array + top-level `schema_version` (json mode).

Add NEW --profile-strict flag (NOT --strict; avoids namespace clash with existing --strict-codes / --validate-plans-strict / --architecture-drift-strict). When set in combination with --profile=<name>, promotes warn -> fail under the selected profile. Default mode keeps advisory/warn/fail severities as ProbeRunner emits them.

JSON envelope under --profile=<name> --json: top-level fields {schema_version: '1.0.0', profile: <name>, generated_at: ISO8601, exit_code: 0|1|2, prereq_probes: [{name, status: pass|warn|advisory|fail|omit, severity_reason, version_found, fix_url, fix_command: list[str], required_for_profiles: list[str], activation_condition: str, activation_resolved: bool, elapsed_s}], legacy_checks: <existing checks>}. Write the local schema doc to docs/plans/2026-05-19-002-feat-install-ux-hardening-v0/evidence/doctor-json-envelope-schema-v1.md.

Backwards-compat invariants: `dontpanic doctor` (no flags) MUST keep its existing render_text + 0/1/2 exit-code matrix and existing check set. `dontpanic doctor --json` (no --profile) MUST keep its existing JSON shape (no new top-level fields). Existing test suite must continue to pass. `dontpanic doctor --profile=core` is the new entry point.

Add fixture tests in scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/tests/test_prereq_registry_f001.py covering: (1) PrereqProbe dataclass field validation; (2) ProfileRegistry profiles are pure sets (no conditional naming); (3) ActivationContext resolves github_remote_present correctly (via mocked git remote); (4) ActivationContext resolves auditor_codex_selected via environments.json; (5) ProbeRunner per-probe timeout enforcement (synthetic slow probe times out at 2s); (6) parallel network probe execution stays under 10s budget for full sweep; (7) JSON envelope schema is stable (snapshot test with field order pinned); (8) `--profile=core` does NOT emit Firebase/agent-conventions output; (9) codex probe is advisory under --profile=core when auditor_codex_selected is false, FAIL under --profile=ci always; (10) gh-auth probe is warn under --profile=core when github_remote_present, omit when not, FAIL under --profile=ci; (11) python<3.10 + missing claude CLI are unconditional fails under core; (12) --profile=unknown returns argparse error with valid profile list; (13) --profile-strict promotes warn -> fail under selected profile.

Add scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/tests/test_doctor_profile_integration.py: (1) `dontpanic doctor` (NO flags) produces byte-identical output to a snapshot of pre-F001 behavior (proves backwards-compat); (2) `dontpanic doctor --profile=core` produces the new profile-aware envelope; (3) `dontpanic doctor --profile=core --json` carries schema_version='1.0.0'; (4) per-profile snapshot covers each of {core, discord, firebase-dashboard, openclaw, ci}; (5) exit-code matrix unchanged for no-flag path.
Write doctor-json-envelope-schema-v1.md to plan evidence/ as the local schema doc (formal agent-conventions promotion deferred per D003). Document each top-level field + the prereq_probes item shape.
Run full orchestrator sweep + sanitization check. Confirm no regressions vs lock-time baseline (do NOT hardcode the count).

features.description: `dontpanic init` interactive installer. New CLI subcommand at scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/init/__init__.py. Defaults to --profile=core. Runs F001's ProbeRunner for the selected profile, renders prereq checklist, executes safe auto-fixes via STRICT ARGV ALLOWLIST (subprocess.run(argv: list[str], shell=False), NEVER shell strings). Per-probe operator confirmation required by default — no `--auto-fix-safe-all` batch flag in v0. Package-manager installs (brew, pip) ship OFF by default: each probe declares auto_install_safe=true to be eligible AND the operator must confirm per-probe in interactive mode. `--non-interactive` flag for agent installers: exits with structured exit code + JSON output instead of prompting. `--json` flag for machine-readable output in any mode. Idempotent re-runs — running `dontpanic init` after a partial fix re-runs ProbeRunner and shows remaining red items.
steps: Read F001's prereq_registry.py + ActivationContext + ProbeRunner + the existing scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/cli.py subcommand wiring pattern. Document the seam where `init` subcommand plugs in.
Create scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/init/__init__.py as a new subpackage. Module entry: init_main(argv: list[str]) -> int returning exit code (0=ready, 1=remaining-fixes, 2=blocked).

Implement Walker class that runs ProbeRunner for selected profile (default --profile=core), groups results by effective severity (fail / warn / advisory / pass), and yields a per-probe interactive prompt for fail+warn items only (advisory items surface as info, no prompt). For each fail/warn probe with auto_install_safe=True: print why_needed + fix_command (as `argv: list[str]`) + 'Run this command? [Y/n]'. For probes with auto_install_safe=False: print why_needed + fix_command + 'Press Enter when done, or Ctrl-C to abort'. Re-run the probe after operator action; continue.

STRICT ARGV ALLOWLIST: auto-fix execution uses subprocess.run(argv: list[str], shell=False, check=False, capture_output=True). The runner NEVER accepts shell strings, NEVER joins probe-declared list[str] with spaces, NEVER invokes /bin/sh -c. Each auto-fix-safe probe declares its command as list[str] in the registry; the runner validates the argv is a list of strings before exec.

Per-probe operator confirmation by default: no `--auto-fix-safe-all` batch flag in v0. Each auto-fix prompts individually. Operator can decline any single fix and continue with the rest. Aborted prompt (Ctrl-C) exits with code 130 cleanly.

Package-manager installs OFF by default: probes that invoke `brew install`, `pip install`, etc. ship with auto_install_safe=False by default; promoting them to auto_install_safe=True requires explicit per-probe operator opt-in (probably v1 — out of scope here; document the gap in non_goals).
Implement --non-interactive mode: if any probe is fail+warn, exit 1 with JSON output listing all such probes + their fix_command + activation context. No prompts, no auto-execution.
Idempotency: each invocation runs ProbeRunner fresh. No persistent state file. Re-running picks up new probe results automatically.

Wire CLI subcommand `dontpanic init` in scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/cli.py with flags: --profile=<name> (DEFAULT 'core', not 'no default'), --non-interactive, --json. Help text references doctor's profile list.

Add fixture tests in scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/tests/test_init_walker_f002.py covering: (1) all-pass path exits 0 with no prompts; (2) fail probe with auto_install_safe=True triggers per-probe prompt in interactive mode + executes via subprocess.run(argv, shell=False) in test mode (use subprocess.run mock to assert argv is list[str] not shell string); (3) fail probe with auto_install_safe=False prompts copy-paste in interactive mode + reports structurally in --non-interactive mode; (4) --non-interactive exits 1 with JSON listing all fail+warn probes; (5) idempotent re-run picks up new probe results without state file; (6) shell-string fix_command in registry raises a validator error at startup (NOT at exec time — fail fast); (7) operator-aborted prompt exits with code 130; (8) advisory items surface in output but NEVER prompt; (9) `dontpanic init` (no flags) defaults to --profile=core (assertion on the resolved profile in test mode); (10) per-probe operator decline allows the loop to continue.

Add scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/tests/test_init_cli_integration.py: spawn `python -m dontpanic_orchestrate init --profile=core --non-interactive --json` as subprocess against a synthetic fixture; assert JSON output structure + exit code + the strict-argv invariant (mock subprocess.run in the test and assert no shell=True calls and no shell-string args).
Run full orchestrator sweep + sanitization check.
features.acceptance: (1) scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/init/__init__.py exposes init_main(argv) entry point. (2) `dontpanic init` defaults to --profile=core (NOT undefined). (3) Walker prompts per-probe operator confirmation for fail+warn items; advisory items NEVER prompt. (4) Auto-fix execution uses subprocess.run(argv: list[str], shell=False) — strict argv allowlist, NEVER shell strings; validator rejects shell-string fix_command at startup. (5) NO `--auto-fix-safe-all` batch flag in v0. (6) Package-manager installs OFF by default; opt-in per probe via auto_install_safe=true. (7) `--non-interactive` flag exits 1 with structured JSON listing fail+warn probes. (8) Idempotent re-runs work without a state file. (9) NEVER auto-creates GitHub PATs, NEVER auto-generates Firebase SA keys, NEVER runs sudo or system-Python modifications. (10) New test modules: test_init_walker_f002.py (>=10 cases) + test_init_cli_integration.py (CLI surface + strict-argv invariant). (11) Full sweep at or above lock-time baseline; sanitization clean.

features.description: `dontpanic smoke --mode=mocked` synthetic supervisor-plumbing test. New CLI subcommand at scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/smoke/__init__.py. Synthetic plan fixture (a 1-feature throwaway plan in a tmpdir, plan ID prefix `2026-05-19-901-smoke-`) + MockClaudeExecutor + MockCodexExecutor that exercise `supervisor.dispatch_volley` end-to-end. **Validates supervisor plumbing only — NOT real CLI presence.** No paid API. No real claude/codex CLI required on host. Real-CLI validation lives in doctor profile probes (F001), NOT in smoke. Acceptance NAMES the exact supervisor surfaces exercised: plan load, gate evaluation, mocked executor envelope write, audit JSON persist, signoff envelope write, INBOX append, tmpdir cleanup. Does NOT claim every supervisor branch — bounded surface set. Bounded <=30s wall clock. Wired into `dontpanic init` as the final step + standalone `dontpanic smoke --mode=mocked`. v0 ships --mode=mocked only; --mode=live (real-CLI integration) deferred.
steps: Read scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/supervisor.py + the existing test_synthetic_disagreement_*.py (F005a-6 fixture) to find the established mock-executor seam. Document the exact supervisor entry points we need to exercise: plan_loader.load, gate_pause.reconcile, executor.run, audit_writer.write, signoff_writer.write, inbox.append, execution_env cleanup.
Create scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/smoke/__init__.py as a new subpackage. Module entry: smoke_main(argv: list[str]) -> int.

Implement SyntheticPlanFixture: creates a tmpdir with a minimal docs/plans/<synthetic-id>/{plan.md, features.json, decisions.jsonl} layout validating against v1.9 schema. plan.md has 1 trivial feature, no child_charter (top-level plan), goal_type=mechanical (no objective_contract required). Synthetic plan ID uses `2026-05-19-901-smoke-feat-synthetic` prefix to be obviously throwaway. tmpdir cleaned up on exit (success OR failure) via context manager.

Implement MockClaudeExecutor + MockCodexExecutor subclasses of BaseExecutor (or equivalent — find the right seam in executor.py). They return fixed claude-implementer-Fxxx-i0.json + codex-auditor-Fxxx-i0.json envelopes with `signed_off` verdict and minimal-but-valid content. NO subprocess.run calls. NO network. NO real CLI lookup. MockExecutor.is_available() returns True unconditionally regardless of whether real CLI is on host.

Implement run_smoke(mode: str = 'mocked') -> SmokeResult that exercises the NAMED supervisor surfaces (NOT every branch): (1) plan_loader.load on synthetic plan; (2) gate_pause.reconcile evaluates pre_impl+pre_merge gates; (3) MockClaudeExecutor.run writes claude-implementer envelope; (4) audit_writer persists to audit/; (5) MockCodexExecutor.run writes codex-auditor envelope (signed_off); (6) signoff_writer writes signoff envelope; (7) inbox.append writes the post-volley event; (8) execution_env tmpdir cleanup runs on success AND on exception. Bounded <=30s wall clock.

SmokeResult includes per-surface status (pass/fail) + elapsed_s + error message if any. Exit code: 0=mocked-supervisor-plumbing-pass, 1=supervisor plumbing defect (real defect — escalate), 2=env blocker (e.g. tmp dir not writable, Python <3.10 — flag as install issue and direct operator to `dontpanic doctor --profile=core`).
Implement smoke output: pretty terminal (per-surface chip with elapsed_s) + --json (structured output with named-surface array + exit code).
Wire CLI subcommand `dontpanic smoke` in scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/cli.py with flags: --mode=mocked (DEFAULT; v0 only mode), --json. Document that --mode=live is reserved for a future plan.

Wire smoke into `dontpanic init` as the final step (post-fix-loop). If init reaches all-green probe status, run smoke automatically; smoke supervisor defect (exit 1) surfaces loud; smoke env blocker (exit 2) re-enters the doctor fix loop.

Add fixture tests in scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/tests/test_smoke_harness_f003.py covering: (1) happy-path smoke with mock executors signed_off exits 0 in <30s; (2) smoke does NOT require real claude/codex CLI on host — explicitly assert MockExecutor.is_available() bypasses real-CLI lookup; (3) supervisor branch failure (e.g. admission rejection) exits 1 with structured error naming the failed surface; (4) tmp dir not writable triggers exit 2 with operator-actionable message pointing at doctor; (5) cleanup happens on exception (tmpdir removed even when supervisor raises); (6) --json output schema is stable (snapshot test); (7) wall clock <30s; (8) named-surface assertion: smoke output enumerates exactly the 8 surfaces in step 5, NOT 'every supervisor branch'.
Run full orchestrator sweep + sanitization check.
features.acceptance: (1) scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/smoke/__init__.py exposes smoke_main(argv) entry point with SyntheticPlanFixture + MockClaudeExecutor + MockCodexExecutor + run_smoke() implementation. (2) `dontpanic smoke --mode=mocked` runs synthetic plan through `supervisor.dispatch_volley` with mocked executors in <=30s wall clock — NO real CLI required, NO paid API, NO network. features.description: HTML install report (Thariq pattern). Single-page artifact at docs/install-report.html. Pure transform from JSON output of `dontpanic doctor --profile=<name> --json` + `dontpanic smoke --mode=mocked --json` into a self-contained HTML5 document. Mirror Plan 4 F002 (architecture_html.py at commit 6032046) style baseline: CSS variables, mobile-first layout, no JS framework, no external CSS, no external fonts. Mobile-responsive (single column <800px, two-column wider). Per-probe status badges (pass/warn/advisory/fail). 'What's next' panel calls out highest-priority fail probe (or 'all green' celebration). Footer links to README + Hermes cheat sheet. Generated by `dontpanic init --report` and `dontpanic doctor --profile=<name> --report`. Output gitignored. Validator type-checks the input payloads against the F001 + F003 JSON envelope schemas; raises InstallReportError with operator-actionable message on shape mismatch. All operator-facing output is html.escape'd at every interpolation seam (mirror Plan 4 F002 D004 defense-in-depth pattern from commit 6032046).
steps: Read scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/architecture_html.py (Plan 4 F002, commit 6032046) for the pattern + style baseline + validator + html.escape pattern. Document the exact CSS variables + render_html signature to keep visual consistency.

Create scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/init/report_html.py: pure transform render_install_report(doctor_payload: dict, smoke_payload: dict | None) -> str returning a single HTML5 string. Mirror architecture_html.py style baseline (CSS variables, mobile-first layout).

Implement validator _validate_doctor_payload + _validate_smoke_payload that type-check input dicts against F001 + F003 JSON envelope schemas. Specifically: doctor payload must have top-level schema_version (string), profile (string), exit_code (int), prereq_probes (list of dicts with name/status/etc); smoke payload (when present) must have top-level schema_version + supervisor_surfaces array. Raise InstallReportError with operator-actionable message on shape mismatch.

Render sections: (a) Header: 'DontPanic install status — profile=<name>' + generated_at + overall verdict chip (ready / fixes-needed / blocked); (b) 'What's next' panel: highest-priority fail probe (or 'all green' celebration); (c) Per-profile prereq checklist: probes grouped by effective status (fail/warn/advisory/pass) with badges + fix_command in code block; (d) Smoke results (when smoke_payload present): per-supervisor-surface chips + elapsed_s; (e) Footer: links to README, Hermes cheat sheet, regen command.

All operator-facing output html.escape'd at every interpolation seam (mirror Plan 4 F002 D004 defense-in-depth pattern). NO raw HTML from probe outputs or smoke surface names reaches the rendered document. Validator rejection above is primary defense; escape is secondary.

Wire `dontpanic doctor --profile=<name> --report [--report-path=PATH]` and `dontpanic init --report` CLI flags. Both invoke render_install_report and write to docs/install-report.html (or override path). Update .gitignore to ignore docs/install-report.html.

Add fixture tests in scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/tests/test_install_report_html_f004.py: (1) valid doctor + smoke payload renders complete document with all sections; (2) doctor-only payload (no smoke) renders cleanly with smoke section omitted; (3) all-pass payload renders 'celebration' variant; (4) fail probe payload renders highest-priority fix prominently; (5) malformed payload raises InstallReportError with actionable message; (6) injection attempt in probe.name / fix_command is escaped (no raw <script> in output); (7) mobile-responsive media query present; (8) generated HTML is well-formed HTML5 (mirror Plan 4 F002 b9 well-formed assertion).
Run full orchestrator sweep + sanitization check. Sanity-check the rendered HTML in Chrome on macOS (operator-side, not test-automated).
